nodes.Name: levelShift
nodes.ValueLiteral: [summaryLevels]uint{heapAddrBits - summaryL0Bits, heapAddrBits - summaryL0Bits - 1*summaryLevelBits, heapAddrBits - summaryL0Bits - 2*summaryLevelBits, heapAddrBits - summaryL0Bits - 3*summaryLevelBits}

nodes.Name: scavengeIndexArray
nodes.DocComment:
scavengeIndexArray is the backing store for p.scav.index.chunks.
On 32-bit platforms, it's small enough to just be a global.

nodes.Name: sysInit
nodes.DocComment:
sysInit initializes the scavengeIndex' chunks array.

Returns the amount of memory added to sysStat.

nodes.Name: sysGrow
nodes.DocComment: sysGrow is a no-op on 32-bit platforms.
